Egg.name: Egg / Incubation Stage
Egg.impact_high_temp: Accelerates embryonic development unevenly, leading to irregular hatching and weak larvae.
Egg.impact_low_temp: Delays hatching significantly and lowers hatching rate percentage.
Egg.impact_high_humidity: Promotes mold and fungal growth on egg cards.
Egg.impact_low_humidity: Causes egg desiccation, preventing larvae from emerging.

Instar 1.name: Instar 1 (Chawki Rearing - 1st Stage)
Instar 1.impact_high_temp: Young larvae dehydrate quickly, lose appetite, and become susceptible to viral flacherie.
Instar 1.impact_low_temp: Sluggish feeding, extended instar duration, and uneven growth across the batch.
Instar 1.impact_high_humidity: Excess moisture causes leaf decay on trays and invites fungal spores.
Instar 1.impact_low_humidity: Chopped mulberry leaves dry out in under 30 minutes, starving young worms.

Instar 2.name: Instar 2 (Chawki Rearing - 2nd Stage)
Instar 2.impact_high_temp: Increased metabolic stress, high larval mortality during moulting.
Instar 2.impact_low_temp: Prolonged moulting period, unequal development of larvae.
Instar 2.impact_high_humidity: High humidity combined with heat causes rapid bacterial buildup in litter.
Instar 2.impact_low_humidity: Leaves wither fast, larvae remain undersized.

Instar 3.name: Instar 3 (Transition Stage)
Instar 3.impact_high_temp: Higher body temperature in larvae, increased susceptibility to Grasserie (NPV).
Instar 3.impact_low_temp: Slow leaf assimilation, poor weight gain prior to 4th instar.
Instar 3.impact_high_humidity: Bed humidity builds up; risk of Flacherie increases.
Instar 3.impact_low_humidity: Leaves dry out quickly, requiring extra feeds per day.

Instar 4.name: Instar 4 (Late Stage - 4th Instar)
Instar 4.impact_high_temp: Excess heat reduces feeding velocity, resulting in smaller silk glands.
Instar 4.impact_low_temp: Worms take longer to complete instar, consuming more total foliage for lower yield.
Instar 4.impact_high_humidity: High moisture leads to wet litter and severe bacterial Flacherie outbreak.
Instar 4.impact_low_humidity: Foliage desiccates, worms spend extra energy eating dry leaves.

Instar 5.name: Instar 5 (Final Rearing & Spinning Stage)
Instar 5.impact_high_temp: Rapid spinning leads to thin, defective silk filaments and double cocoons.
Instar 5.impact_low_temp: Spinning is delayed; worms may fail to mount properly.
Instar 5.impact_high_humidity: Cocoons become soft, stained, and moldy; reellability drops drastically.
Instar 5.impact_low_humidity: Silk thread breaks during spinning due to rapid moisture loss.
